newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock index futures end topsy-turvy day lower.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock index futures end topsy-turvy day lower.

text.p: Feb 19 - U.S. stock index futures ended a topsy-turvy day on the downside. As usual, the heaviest selling of the session was generated after the U.S. bond futures closed at 1400 CST/2000 GMT. Some traders were disappointed by the U.S. bond market's reaction to U.S. data suggesting low inflation. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com))
